correctness.rationale: The deterministic percolation run identity h N_h-(h-1) N_(h+1) exactly counts vertices in open path components of length at least h. Taking expectations gives F_m=h(m-h+1)p^(h-1)-(h-1)(m-h)p^h for m>=h and zero otherwise. For a single deletion a+b=n-1: tail-minimum profiles have one small gap of h-1 and one residual large gap, or both <h; strict excess of having two active gaps is (h-1)p^h/(n-1). The mean follows from H_m=sum_(d=1)^(m-1)(m-d)p^d and strict discrete convexity, hence balanced splitting. Boundary n=2h checked. Independent exact state-enumeration verified 156 parameter cases. C PASS is for the entire claimed theorem, not for logs alone.
residual_risks: Finite check alone would not establish all n,h; the algebraic gap proof supplies the infinite claim.
